name: Portfolio Watch
description: Tracks your stocks and crypto: the daily close on weekdays at 4:30 PM, alerts on big moves and price targets, and answers how you're doing. Numbers only, never advice.

settings.label: Your holdings
settings.help: One per line: symbol, quantity, @ what you paid each. Stocks by US ticker; crypto BTC, ETH, SOL, DOGE, ADA, XRP. Example: AAPL 10 @ 182.50

settings.label: Big move alert (%)
settings.help: Alert me when a holding moves this much in a day, once per symbol per day. Example: 5
